versions.changelog: Public candidate v1.0.22: reviewed Linear native Node helper with read commands, explicit write gate, bounded inputs, public package hygiene, and local tests.
Polish Linear public-ready source: approval-gated write wording, prefix-only global flags, workspace-sensitive error-body omission, and public package hygiene excluding dry-runs evidence.
ClawHub publication/version refresh after public-readiness review; no runtime behavior change.
Reject extra positional args for Linear commands to prevent truncated operator intent
Clarify execute approval gate and mutation appropriateness requirements.

Tighten public docs for Linear key permissions, team/default-team behavior, write approval wording, pagination/rate-limit behavior, help support, sample-output scanability, and consistent --limit validation.
Security/audit polish: document the write-command approval gate and expected static-analysis warning for env-var plus fixed Linear endpoint usage. No functional API behavior change.
Add fail-closed --execute gate for Linear write commands and align setup examples.
Package metadata cleanup: restore display name and tags after v1.0.6 package-only release.
Package-only cleanup: publish runtime files only and remove the local test harness from the public archive; keeps the v1.0.5 GraphQL query fix.
Fix GraphQL variable construction in issue list queries (issues/my-issues/my-todos/urgent/standup) that broke in 1.0.4.
Corrective package-only release: removes test harness from the published archive; keeps reviewed v1.0.3 code/docs behavior with only SKILL.md and scripts/linear.mjs.
Corrective release: publishes the final reviewed source package with clean examples, PowerShell-safe setup text, env-only credentials, and ASCII-clean docs/scripts.
Public polish: env-only credentials, ASCII-clean docs and examples, scanner-warning clarity, and package consistency checks.
Scanner cleanup: remove ~/.openclaw/.env file-reading fallback from public package; credentials are read from process environment only.
Initial public release: native Node.js Linear GraphQL helper with read commands and approval-gated write commands.
